newsitem.title: GERMANY: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF GIANT SLALOM WINNER COMPAGNONI.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF GIANT SLALOM WINNER COMPAGNONI.

text.p: Following is a brief profile of Deborah Compagnoni, winner of a women's World Cup giant slalom on Saturday:
World Cup wins: 10. Slalom: Semmering (96), Giant Slalom:
Tignes (93), Veysonnaz (93), Morzine (94), Haus (95), Narvik (96), Zwiesel (Jan 17, Jan 18, 97). Super-G- Morzine (92,93)
Other feats: 1992 Olympic super-G gold medal, 1994 Olympic giant slalom gold medal, 1996 world championship giant slalom gold medal.

Compagnoni has overcome illness in her youth and serious injury to return to the ski racing elite. She left the national ski federation two years ago to train alone with personal coach Dino Pietrogiovanna. Will not compete in super-G this season, concentrating instead on the technical discipline. Heads for races in Italy next week looking for first World Cup triumph on home soil.
